_source: Captured 2026-06-02 from a maintainer/community S7 Flashdry showing 'Insufficient water' in the Tineco app (home-assistant_tineco log line 544). gci payload values are real; device metadata matches the known S7 Flashdry shape. PII (did/email/tokens) scrubbed.
_regression_note: The device reports insufficient/low clean water via the wp sentinel (wp=238) while e1/e2/e3 are all 0. Decoded from the Tineco app (FloorThreeDeviceFragment/FloorFourDeviceFragment.setBatteryAndWater): wp in {238,239,240} drives the water-error icon. The fresh water tank sensor must report 'empty' here; previously it only checked e2/e3 and wrongly reported 'full'.
